notes.note: Reviewed remote Project sharing consent from production route through ProjectMembershipService.withProject and file lease, then ConsentTransactionStore terminal outcomes and status poll. Deliberate session_ended/target_changed refusals now cross the lease as membership refusal data and are unwrapped outside; final synchronous check still precedes mutation. Existing origin/session/Project identity and no-write promises remain accurate. Strengthened existing production-composition revocation cases failed commit_refused before fix and pass terminal response/status with no membership notification or successful-enable audit afterward. No physical passkey/browser/hosted deployment acceptance inferred.
